section.title: Questions?
section.defaultIntro: Eligibility, ages, experience, and certificates — the essentials for families and students considering the next step.
section.stillCurious: Still curious? <link>Ask us anything</link> — we're happy to help you find the right pathway.

eligibility.question: Who is eligible to join {name}?
eligibility.answer: {name} welcomes students from grades 3-12 who have an interest in robotics, STEM, and innovation. No prior experience is required for beginner courses.

ageGroups.question: What age groups do you serve?
ageGroups.answer: We serve students aged 8-18 years old, with courses tailored to different age groups and skill levels. Our programs are designed to grow with students from elementary through high school.

background.question: Do I need any background knowledge?
background.answer: No background knowledge is required for our beginner courses. We start from the basics and guide you through every step. For intermediate and advanced courses, we recommend completing prerequisite courses first.

certificates.question: Do you provide certificates?
certificates.answer: Yes! Students who complete our courses receive certificates of completion. We also provide certificates for participation in competitions and special workshops.

register.question: How do I register for an event?
register.answer: Open the event, fill in the registration form with the student’s name, email and phone number, and submit. Free events are confirmed instantly; paid events take you to bKash to complete payment.

pay.question: How do I pay for a paid event?
pay.answer: Payments are made securely through bKash. After you submit the form you are redirected to bKash checkout — stay on the page until you see the “Payment Successful” screen.

lostId.question: I lost my registration ID. What should I do?
lostId.answer: Your registration ID is in your confirmation email and the attached PDF — search your inbox (and spam folder) for “Robonauts”. If you still can’t find it, message us on WhatsApp at {phone} with the student’s name and the event, and we’ll resend it.

refund.question: Can I cancel or get a refund?
refund.answer: Please see our Refund & Cancellation Policy, or message us on WhatsApp and we’ll help.
